title: 받침 ㄱ·ㄷ·ㅂ: 끝소리 멈추기 연습
summary: Practice reading and producing unreleased final stops for batchim ㄱ/ㄷ/ㅂ. Learners link each to similar English word-final sounds (back/bat/cap) but with no release, then read and choose simple words that contain these batchim.
objective: Beginner learners will produce unreleased final stops [k], [t], [p] for batchim ㄱ, ㄷ, ㅂ; connect them to similar English endings (“back/bat/cap” with no release); and accurately read and select simple Korean words that contain these batchim.

task.title: Say it: stop the final sound
task.line: Read aloud: 국도 드세요. / 문 닫고 나가세요. / 밥 주세요. At each ㄱ/ㄷ/ㅂ batchim, block the air with the back of your tongue (ㄱ), the tip of your tongue (ㄷ), or your lips (ㅂ) and stop without releasing the sound.

exercises: Choose the word whose final sound is [k]: (국 / 곧 / 밥)
What is the final sound of this word? 곧 (k / t / p)
Which English word ending is closest to the final sound of 받 in 받다? (back / bat / cap)
Choose the correct romanization: 벽 (byeok / byeog / byuk)
Read the sentence aloud, stopping 「집」 without releasing the final sound. Then choose its final sound: 우리 집 좋아요. (k / t / p)
